model: x'=v; v'=a; a'=r*(u-a); r fixed per run; clip(-x-3v-2a) in[-1,1]
scope: Numerical illustration only. No parameter search, interval certification, Lean proof, or physical validation. Only the nominal center belongs to the currently proved small initial box.

metric_notes.peak_abs_travel: Analytic segment extrema, with velocity roots bisected numerically60 times; not outward-rounded bounds.
metric_notes.terminal_V: Computed at exactly T1.25 for both policies.
metric_notes.command_total_variation: Sum of absolute changes between held commands; excludes a jump from an unspecified prehistory command.
metric_notes.command_absolute_integral: Exact held-command time integral evaluated in floating point; command effort proxy, not physical energy.
metric_notes.post_T_sampled_peak_V: Numerically sampled; not an all-time assertion.
